headline: Calibrated on the Ubx arm alone, a one-dimensional Hox-dose model predicts the independently measured Antp transformation threshold to within 4% (graded variant, gfp_10.5 protein ratio), which is quantitative support for Paul et al.'s claim that wing-versus-haltere is set by Hox DOSE rather than Hox identity - but the two protein-ratio measurements in that same paper disagree enough to move the prediction by a factor of 1.76.

model.kind: ODE, one state variable (Vg-Sd wing-selector activity W)
model.equation: dW/dt = (alpha*W^n/(K^n+W^n) + beta) * 1/(1+(X/kx)^m) - gamma*W, X = Ubx + Antp/ratio

variants.bistable: Cooperative self-activation (n=4). Parameters were chosen so this variant gets a FAIR test rather than a strawman one: beta is large enough that with Hox repression fully relieved the low state does not exist, so a naive T2 disc ignites into a wing on its own, and wild-type T2 and T3 both sit OUTSIDE the bistable window. It has a genuine bistable window at intermediate Hox dose and therefore predicts hysteresis.
variants.graded: Non-cooperative self-activation (n=1). Has no bistable window at any Hox dose, so it predicts a single-valued, continuous dose-response with intermediate organs at intermediate doses.

model.organ_call_declared: before any sweep was run, in the module docstring

parameters.name: Ubx threshold for wing traits
parameters.source: Paul et al. 2021, Nat Commun 12:2892, PMID 34001903 (full text): wing-like traits appear when Ubx falls to 39% of endogenous

parameters.name: Antp threshold for haltere-like wing
parameters.source: Paul et al. 2021, PMID 34001903 (full text): wing resembles a haltere at 490% of endogenous Antp

parameters.name: endogenous Ubx:Antp protein ratio (antibody)
parameters.source: Paul et al. 2021, PMID 34001903 (full text): 'Ubx was 18.5 times more strongly expressed than Antp'

parameters.name: endogenous Ubx:Antp protein ratio (GFP fusions)
parameters.source: Paul et al. 2021, PMID 34001903 (full text): matched anti-GFP quantification gives 10.5x; the authors report both numbers

parameters.name: n (Hill coefficient, Vg-Sd self-activation)
parameters.source: No measurement of Vg-Sd autoregulatory cooperativity is known to me. The two values are the two model variants, and the point of running both is that the published intermediate phenotypes discriminate between them.

parameters.name: K (half-activation of self-activation)
parameters.source: chosen so both variants admit a wing state

parameters.name: alpha (max production)
parameters.source: sets the wing steady state near W=1 with gamma=1

parameters.name: beta (basal production)
parameters.source: small leak so the haltere state is low but not identically zero

parameters.name: gamma (degradation)
parameters.source: sets the time unit; the model has no real clock

parameters.name: m (Hox repression Hill coefficient)
parameters.source: Ubx binds many wing-programme enhancers; the cooperativity of the aggregate repression is not measured

parameters.name: kx (Hox dose for half repression)
parameters.source: the single fitted parameter, fitted to the Ubx arm ONLY so the Antp arm is a prediction and not a fit

controls.detail: per variant and per protein-ratio, under results.variants

calibration.fitted_to: the Ubx arm only (wing traits at 39% of endogenous Ubx)
calibration.arm_held_out: the Antp arm (haltere-like wing at 490% of endogenous Antp)

prediction.note: The two protein-ratio measurements in the SAME paper disagree (18.5x by antibody, 10.5x by matched GFP fusions). That disagreement propagates directly into this prediction and is the dominant source of error in it. Both are reported; neither is preferred here.

sweep.note: W at steady state from a neutral initial condition (W0=0.5) at every cell. Axes are Ubx as a fraction of endogenous T3 Ubx and Antp as a multiple of endogenous T2 Antp.

limitations: This is a cartoon. The real decision involves at least vg, sd, wg, dpp, the EGFR/Ras pathway, sal, SRF/blistered and the achaete-scute complex, all of which Ubx regulates (Weatherbee 1998 PMID 9585507; Mohit 2006 PMID 16414040; Pallavi 2006 PMID 16815386). The model has ONE state variable standing for all of them.

The Hox-dose assumption (Ubx and Antp interchangeable up to a scale factor) is known to be false for distant Hox proteins: Paul et al. show Abd-A rescues the four-winged phenotype and Scr does not. The model would be wrong for Scr.

kx is fitted, so the model cannot be said to predict the Ubx threshold - only the Antp one. With a single fitted parameter and a single held-out number, the test is weak; it would be much stronger against a dose series, which the paper reports qualitatively but not as tabulated numbers I could extract.

Time is nondimensional. gamma=1 sets the unit and the model says nothing about how long the decision actually takes, nor about the fact that Ubx acts at several successive stages of haltere morphogenesis (Pavlopoulos & Akam 2011, PMID 21282633).
The readout W is an abstraction scored against a threshold declared in advance; it is not any measured quantity. Calling W>0.5 'a wing' is a modelling convention, not an observation.

Spatial structure is absent. The real decision happens across a disc with compartment boundaries and a Dpp gradient whose RANGE Ubx controls (Crickmore & Mann 2006, PMID 16741075); a well-mixed ODE cannot represent that, and organ SIZE - which is most of what Ubx does - is outside the model entirely.

hysteresis_test_model_independent.logic: A hysteretic switch REQUIRES the haltere-to-wing transition to sit at a strictly lower Hox dose than the wing-to-haltere transition. The two published thresholds are measured on opposite branches, so their ordering tests hysteresis directly, with no model in between.
hysteresis_test_model_independent.verdict: Under BOTH protein-ratio measurements the ordering is the one a hysteretic switch forbids: the haltere-to-wing dose is the HIGHER of the two. Under the GFP ratio the two doses are within 4% of each other, i.e. effectively a single threshold. So the published numbers do not support a bistable switch with a usable hysteresis window, and they are consistent with a graded, single-valued readout of Hox dose - which is also what Paul et al. report qualitatively when they say intermediate Hox levels give intermediate organs.
hysteresis_test_model_independent.caveat: The two thresholds were scored on different traits (wing veins, hairs and flattening appearing in a haltere; size, shape and hair organisation making a wing resemble a haltere) and in different tissues. They are not two readings of one instrument, so a modest disagreement between them is expected and the 4% agreement under the GFP ratio should not be over-read.

post_hoc_verification.added_by: the agent that completed the page, after study 1 was built
post_hoc_verification.what_was_checked: Study 1 depends on four numbers attributed to Paul et al. 2021 (PMID 34001903). None of them is in that paper's PubMed abstract. The full text is open access and was fetched this session (Europe PMC, PMC8129201; stored at data/paul2021-PMC8129201-fulltext.xml, sha256 4e12dc00acaf5c3d21f2e8690ec56f53646cc3a80b87c656c45dfc56b59c6d92) and all four were confirmed verbatim.

confirmed.39 percent of endogenous Ubx: 'characteristic wing-like phenotypic traits (including veins, hairs organization, and flattening) eventually appeared when the level decreased to 39% of endogenous Ubx (2.5 times lower than endogenous Ubx)'
confirmed.490 percent of endogenous Antp: 'the wing resembled a haltere in terms of size, shape, and hairs organization when the expression level corresponded to 490% of endogenous Antp'
confirmed.18.5x by antibody: 'Ubx was 18.5 times more strongly expressed than Antp'
confirmed.10.5x by GFP: 'Ubx expression levels were 10.5 times higher than Antp levels'

post_hoc_verification.correction_to_this_study_s_framing: This study's `prediction.note` calls the two protein-ratio measurements a disagreement that 'propagates directly' into the prediction. That is true arithmetically, but it understates what the paper says: Paul et al. do not leave the two numbers in conflict. They attribute the gap to antibody affinity and conclude that 'the Antp antibody is 1.85 times less affine', which makes the GFP-based 10.5x their own preferred measurement. The GFP arm is also the arm whose held-out prediction lands within 4%. So the model comparison and the paper's own reasoning select the same number, independently - which is a stronger result than this study originally claimed, not a weaker one.
post_hoc_verification.independent_support_for_the_graded_varia: The paper states directly, of both the Antp and the Ubx series, that 'In both cases, intermediate levels led to intermediary phenotypes'. That is an OBSERVATION of intermediate organs at intermediate doses, which is what this study's graded variant predicts and what its bistable variant forbids. It was not used to build the model and it is not part of the 4% prediction; it is a separate, qualitative confirmation of the variant the quantitative test already selected.
post_hoc_verification.figure_fix: The control figure's y-axis was pinned to (-0.03, 1.05) while the bistable variant's wing branch settles at about 1.61, so that curve ran off the top of the panel and the panel read as a MISSING curve rather than a high one. The axis now follows the data. No model code was changed.
post_hoc_verification.stale_result_found_and_refreshed: The inherited hox-identity.json was NOT the output of the hox_identity.py beside it. Re-running the code unchanged - the only edit was a figure axis limit - moved the bistable variant's held-out prediction from 200 (i.e. it never crossed) to 6.82, flipped controls.all_variants_pass from false to true, rewrote both variant descriptions, and added a whole `hysteresis_test_model_independent` section that no earlier result carried. So the code had been revised and never re-run, and the emitted result described a superseded model. The refreshed result is the one in this file. It is also the better one: the bistable variant now passes the same controls as the graded one, which makes the comparison a fair test rather than a strawman, and the discrimination it reports (4.0% vs 39.2% on the GFP protein ratio) is smaller and more credible than the 40-fold gap the stale file implied.
post_hoc_verification.not_changed: No model code, parameter, control or conclusion was altered by hand. The only edit to hox_identity.py was a figure axis limit; everything else here is that file's own output, refreshed.
